# AASpriteStacker (@aastack/*) — Frontier AI Agent SDK Specification

Zero-dependency, mobile-first, anti-aliased 6-DOF & 2.5D sprite-stacking rendering engine for WebGL2.

## Coordinate Convention
- **World Space:** Right-handed Y-up (`+X` right, `+Y` up/altitude, `-Z` forward).
- **Voxel Asset Space:** `[0..W, 0..L, 0..H]` (`+X` right, `+Y` nose/forward, `+Z` up/roof).
  - `mat4AssetToLocal` maps asset `(x, y, z)` to world `(x - pivotX, z - pivotZ, -(y - pivotY)) * voxelScale`.

## Quickstart (`@aastack/core` + `@aastack/blueprint`)
```ts
import { AASpriteRenderer, SceneWorld, quatFromYawPitchRoll } from "@aastack/core";
import { compileBlueprint, createFighterJetBlueprint } from "@aastack/blueprint";

const world = new SceneWorld({ seed: 11 });
const renderer = new AASpriteRenderer(canvas, { quality: "auto", adaptiveDpr: true });

world.registerAsset(compileBlueprint(createFighterJetBlueprint("jet-asset")));
world.applyPatch([
  { op: "set", path: "style", value: "arcade-8bit" }, // "arcade-8bit" | "hd-2d" | "smooth-toy" | "retro-raw"
  { op: "set", path: "aaMode", value: "voxel-dda" },  // "voxel-dda" | "smooth-sdf" | "legacy"
  { op: "spawn", entity: { id: "jet", assetId: "jet-asset", pos: [0, 30, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0, 1], scale: 1, outline: true, castShadow: true, tag: "player" } },
]);

function loop(dt: number) {
  world.stepClock(dt);
  renderer.render(world);
}
```

## First-Principles Iterative Hooks
1. **Patchable SceneIR:** `world.applyPatch(ops)` (`"set" | "spawn" | "remove" | "updateEntity"`), `world.undo()`, `world.redo()`.
2. **Deterministic Time-Travel:** `const snap = world.snapshot(); world.restore(snap);`
3. **Hot-Swappable Asset Registry:** `world.registerAsset(newAsset)` updates GPU 3D textures automatically by content hash.
4. **Semantic Sockets:** `world.getSocketWorldPos("jet", "wingtipL")` for contrails, turrets, weapons, and `cockpitCam`.
5. **Spatial Queries (1:1 with Rendered Pixels):** `world.sampleTerrainHeight(x, z)` and `world.raycastEntities(ro, rd, maxDist)`.
6. **Introspection & QA:** `renderer.getStats()` (FPS, frameMs, DRS, DPR, drawCalls, isMobile) and `renderer.captureDataUrl(world)`.

## Asset Ingest Formats
- **Declarative Blueprints (`@aastack/blueprint`):** `compileBlueprint({ id, size: [W,L,H], voxelScale, ops: [box|sphere|ellipsoid|capsule|wedge|torus|paint], sockets })`. Supports `subtract: true` (hollow cavities), `mirrorX: true`, `emissive: true`.
- **MagicaVoxel `.vox`:** `parseVox(arrayBuffer, { id, voxelScale })`.
- **Horizontal `slices.png` strips:** `loadSliceStripPixels(rgba, stripW, stripH, { id, slices })`.
- **4-View Orthographic PNGs (Python CLI):** `python3 skills/aa-sprite-stacking/scripts/aa_views_to_slices.py views.png slices.png --slices 36 --sdf sdf.png --preview check.png`.

## MCP Server (`@aastack/mcp`)
Tools: `aastack_compile_blueprint`, `aastack_inspect_vox`, `aastack_carve_4view`, `aastack_validate_scene_ir`, `aastack_get_sdk_spec`.
